facts.fact: BootControl is a Rust bootloader manager for Linux (GRUB 2, systemd-boot/UKI, Secure Boot MOK, UEFI BootOrder/BootNext) positioned as a replacement for Grub Customizer; v0.1.0 alpha, GPL-3.0.
Three unprivileged frontends (CLI bootcontrol/clap, TUI/ratatui, GUI/slint) talk over the system D-Bus to a single root daemon bootcontrold; only the daemon runs as root via systemd/D-Bus activation.

The D-Bus interface org.bootcontrol.Manager exposes writes: set_grub_settings, set_grub_value, set_grub_default, rebuild_grub_config, backup_nvram, sign_and_enroll_uki, set_loader_default, rename_loader_entry, add/remove_kernel_param, restore_snapshot, set_boot_order, set_boot_next, clear_boot_next; reads include read_grub_config, list_loader_entries, list_efi_boot_entries, get_boot_order.

Four per-intent Polkit actions (rewrite-grub, write-bootloader, enroll-mok, restore-snapshot); enroll-mok requires auth_admin every time, others auth_admin_keep for active sessions. D-Bus bus policy lets any user call the interface, root only owns the name. Daemon refuses to start on the system bus if the policy file fails validate_policy_file.

bootcontrold main reads BOOTCONTROL_BUS (session vs system), BOOTCONTROL_GRUB_PATH, BOOTCONTROL_FAILSAFE_PATH, BOOTCONTROL_SNAPSHOT_ROOT, BOOTCONTROL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECS; BOOTCONTROL_UKI_DIR/ENTRY_TOKEN_PATH only under polkit-mock feature on session bus. Non-Linux builds produce a stub that exits 1.

facts.topic: external process execution by root daemon
facts.fact: Daemon shells out to grub-mkconfig/grub2-mkconfig, dracut, kernel-install, mkinitcpio, rpm-ostree, sbsign, mokutil, and `sh` in failsafe generation, resolved via which or constants.

Write targets: /etc/default/grub, /etc/bootcontrol/failsafe.cfg, /var/lib/bootcontrol/snapshots/, /boot/efi, /boot/grub, /boot/loader, /etc/kernel, efivars NVRAM; systemd unit uses ProtectSystem=full with ReadWritePaths for those boot/etc dirs plus StateDirectory/ConfigurationDirectory=bootcontrol.

Cargo workspace (resolver 2, edition 2021) with crates core, daemon, cli, tui, gui, gui-spike, client and tests/e2e; key deps zbus 5 (tokio), zbus_polkit 5.1, nix 0.29, sha2, serde_json, which 7. Daemon feature polkit-mock compiles out the real Polkit client.

Documented commands: `cargo build --workspace`; `cargo test --workspace`; `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`; `cargo test --workspace --all-features`; E2E: `BOOTCONTROL_BUS=session dbus-run-session -- cargo test -p bootcontrol-e2e --all-features --test e2e -- --ignored --test-threads=1`; optional `cargo check --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --workspace --exclude bootcontrol-e2e`; demo: `BOOTCONTROL_DEMO=1 cargo run -p bootcontrol-cli -- get-config`.

No cloud CI; gating is via opt-in local git hooks (.githooks pre-commit, pre-push, commit-msg) running scripts/ci-local.sh, which first runs python3 scripts/test-pre-push.py; hooks can be bypassed by the local operator. Cross-distro containers (ubuntu, fedora, arch) via scripts/test-in-distro.sh.

Packaging artifacts: polkit policy, D-Bus system.d conf, D-Bus activation service, systemd service+socket, /etc/grub.d/40_bootcontrol hook, rpm spec, AUR PKGBUILD, .desktop, policy.toml.example, man pages; manual install copies the daemon to /usr/bin/bootcontrold.
Client resolve_backend returns MockBackend when BOOTCONTROL_DEMO is set or the target is not Linux; README states Linux bus failures are errors, never silent demo fallback.

Docs claim ETag + flock/tmp/fsync/rename atomic writes, kernel-param blacklist sanitizer, complex-Bash bail-out, pre-write snapshots, GRUB failsafe menuentry, atomic-distro preflight; systemd-boot BootCounting is explicitly not implemented, and async JobId layer remains open.
Sources name Grub Customizer as the comparable/replaced tool and reference efibootmgr-like UEFI BootOrder/BootNext management plus rpm-ostree kargs delegation.

crates/gui-spike holds accessibility experiments (q3_live_region, q4_focus_trap, etc.) and .claude/ holds agent history/task briefs; neither is a product execution path. No third_party directory exists in the snapshot.

gaps: Snapshot has no Git metadata, so the accepted SHA cannot be verified against the tree.
Cargo.lock present but not inspected for exact resolved dependency versions or advisories.
No local runtime facts: no evidence of which distro, kernel, Polkit or D-Bus versions the daemon has been deployed on; nothing was executed.
Polkit authorize() implementation (crates/daemon/src/polkit.rs) and KNOWN_ACTIONS not yet read; mapping of each D-Bus method to its action ID unverified.
packaging/policy.toml.example purpose and whether daemon reads a runtime policy file not yet established.
Snapshot root directory permissions, efivars write path, and NVRAM backup destination handling (crates/daemon/src/secureboot/nvram.rs) not yet read.
Windows UEFI backend is scaffold-only per README; no Windows-side code path reviewed.
Hook test scripts (scripts/test-pre-push.py, test-toolkit-push-gates.py, release.sh) not read; their write locations unknown.
